page_inventory.summary: newspaper front page: 'DIARIO DE POESÍA' masthead, 'Segunda Edición' banner, lead blurb, several articles and photos; sticky note and a red box annotation
'2/SUMARIO': contents list, 'Editorial', 'Alta Marea' column, colophon/staff box, facsimile drawing
'REPORTAJE/3': large headline 'Ginsberg, treinta años después', multi-column interview text with photos
'4/POESIA NORTEAMERICANA': Allen Ginsberg, translated by Eduardo Stupía, poem 'Sudario Blanco'
'18/DOSSIER JUANELE': two Yannis Ritsos poems, translated by Juan L. Ortiz, headed 'La sonata del claro de luna'
'AGENDA/35': article 'Sin riesgo no hay ganancia' plus bibliographic listings in columns; large vertical letters on the right edge

Dates inside content (e.g. 'Hasta el 15 de septiembre de 1986', 'de agosto', 'el 15 de noviembre') are event deadlines, not publication dates.

losses.what: photographs (portraits, group photo captioned 'De izq. a der.: P. Orlovsky, L. Ferlinghetti, W. Burroughs, G. Corso, C. Holmes, A. Ginsberg, C. Solomon y, sentado, R. Frank.', a 1920s-style nude portrait)
losses.why_unrepresentable: image content has no text equivalent; the caption can be kept but not who is actually pictured

losses.what: masthead lettering and large display type
losses.why_unrepresentable: typography (big blocky 'POESÍA', drop caps, 'SEGUNDA EDICIÓN' diagonal banner) carries identity and emphasis

losses.what: scan quality, grey background, show-through of the reverse side on page 1/2
losses.why_unrepresentable: scan artefact; shows up as visual noise only

losses.what: archive watermark footer on every page
losses.why_unrepresentable: added by the digitizer, not part of the original; a structural record cannot tell original from overlay without a note

losses.what: text in small columns beyond my reading resolution (agenda listings on p.6, body of p.3-5)
losses.why_unrepresentable: I did not read these in full; only headlines/bylines were recorded

uncertainties.reason: appearance is a grey halftone newspaper scan with show-through; I did not test selecting text; the sticky note says there is no text layer, but that is another reader's claim
two date statements disagree; 'Segunda edición' on the cover adds a possible reprint date
digit reads 18 at my resolution and matches Sumario 'Sonata del claro de luna ... 18'
pages 4 and 5 are columnar text under a single heading, so I set False; pages 1, 2, 3, 6 mix photos, boxes and callouts
front-page layout has no single reading path

notes: Excerpt pages are non-contiguous in the original issue: printed 1, 2, 3, 4, 18, 35. All six pages are portrait, no rotation. I read headlines, bylines and the Sumario carefully; body text mostly skimmed.
